title: Redux Saga
description: Learn complex async patterns with Redux Saga.

data.text: **Redux Saga** is a middleware for handling complex side effects using generator functions. It's powerful for complex async flows.
Sagas use generator functions and effects (call, put, take, etc.) to orchestrate async operations.

data.title: Saga
When to Use Sagas
data.text: Sagas are great for complex async flows: debouncing, chaining, cancellation. For simple async, thunks or createAsyncThunk are simpler.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Thunks are simpler for basic async
data.takeaway: Sagas handle complex async patterns in Redux.
